## Session Recap

The party infiltrates the old toll house on the causeway, discovering a rear guard and overhearing plans to move a ledger and use the Moon Gate. Thorn subdues the rear guard while Lysa casts Sleep to incapacitate a cultist. Bram kicks in the front door, chasing a robed figure upstairs who attempts to escape with a satchel. Mira retrieves the satchel, which contains a ledger and the silver signet from the missing ferryman, and incapacitates the robed man. Lysa identifies the green flame bowl as a signaling device and disables it. The party decides to take the ledger, the signet, and the rear guard captive, leaving the robed man tied up. Mira finds the name "Edda Voss" in the ledger, revealing that the east dock office clerk is involved in the conspiracy. The group resolves to bring the captive back to town rather than hand the ledger to the magistrate, and they agree to leave the dangerous robed cultist tied up in the upstairs room.
